qualityGates.label: License boundary
qualityGates.rule: Do not bundle or redistribute third-party postal, map, boundary, or population datasets unless the source license explicitly permits it.

qualityGates.label: Governance and official status
qualityGates.rule: AGID Postal Forge outputs are simulation/draft unless a government, municipality, postal authority, or carrier pilot authority is explicitly recorded.

qualityGates.label: Minimum anonymity
qualityGates.rule: A public postal zone cannot identify a single household, sensitive facility, or high-risk refuge location.

qualityGates.label: Data trust threshold
qualityGates.rule: Address, road, admin, population, and boundary evidence must pass the configured trust threshold before public pilot use.

qualityGates.label: Existing postal non-replacement
qualityGates.rule: Class A mature postal countries cannot be replaced by AGID-generated postal codes; Class B countries only allow supplemental codes.

qualityGates.label: Country and municipality boundary
qualityGates.rule: Generated postal zones must stay inside one country, and user-selected locality codes must not cross municipalities.

qualityGates.label: Readability and error distance
qualityGates.rule: Public code sets should avoid visually confusable adjacent codes and keep human entry practical.

qualityGates.label: Lineage and migration safety
qualityGates.rule: Split, merge, rename, and reshaping events must keep old-to-new mappings and preserve stable locality IDs when names change.

privacyRules: The pack contains metadata, templates, quality gates, and synthetic fixtures only.
The pack must not contain personal addresses, recipient names, phone numbers, private AOID bodies, AGID-S payloads, proof codes, or precise high-risk coordinates.
Country classification is a design prior, not proof of deliverability or official postal authority approval.
High-risk and humanitarian contexts default to coarse, revocable, non-public codes.
consumerRules: Use Class A countries as non-replacement baselines only.
Use Class B countries for supplemental AGID postal drafts only.
Use Class C countries for primary AGID postal draft design, not automatic official issuance.
Run license review before bundling any third-party geography, postal, population, road, or boundary dataset.
Keep AGID as an internal stable key so visible postal formats can be reshaped later.
